ownerVisualGate.question: 游戏里的提示是否稳定跟随正确的人物/怪物？请输入 YES 或 NO
ownerVisualGate.automaticPrerequisite: P17 must be exactly READY_FOR_OWNER_VISUAL_CONFIRMATION with W3 PASS/proven renderer source, P16 HUD_INGEST_ACCEPTED, P18 CANONICAL_DRAW_ACKNOWLEDGED, exact identity consistency, and unchanged safety.
ownerVisualGate.yesEffect: Writes a bounded real Owner PASS receipt bound to exact candidate/attestation/bundle hashes and identity; does not promote alpha-live.
ownerVisualGate.noEffect: Writes an immutable FAIL receipt for that candidate/bundle combination and permanently blocks that receipt from promotion.
ownerVisualGate.notReadyEffect: Writes WAITING/REJECTED status with questionAsked=false; never asks a misleading visual question.
ownerVisualGate.fixturePolicy: fixture-mode PASS/FAIL receipts are marked promotionEligible=false and cannot authorize a plan.

promotionGate.planState: READY only after real Owner PASS
promotionGate.cas: fromAlphaLiveCommit is re-read immediately before apply; any observed drift is rejected.
explicitApplyRequirements: target is a descendant of current alpha-live
target contains the W1 permanent release files
promotionGate.localBareRepoApplyTest: PASS via object fetch + exact-old git update-ref CAS after explicit fast-forward validation
promotionGate.realRemotePolicy: normal non-force push only after immediate CAS-style re-read; observed drift or normal push rejection fails closed; no force/force-with-lease/+refspec.

ownerGate.nextOwnerAction: After P19 emits/verifies its final candidate pointer and P17 can reach READY_FOR_OWNER_VISUAL_CONFIRMATION, run parallel\OWNER_RELEASE\WOF_ALPHA_FINAL_RELEASE_GATE.cmd once and answer the single question from real WOF observation with YES or NO.
ownerGate.nextPmActionAfterYes: Review the emitted immutable receipt and ALPHA_LIVE_PROMOTION_PLAN_<hash>.json. A later, separate PM release action may invoke owner_release_gate.py apply with --execute and the exact plan hash; P20 itself did not invoke it.

nextAction: Use WOF_ALPHA_FINAL_RELEASE_GATE.cmd only after P19/P17 live prerequisites are ready. Keep alpha-live unchanged until a real Owner YES receipt exists and a separate PM explicitly applies the exact hashed plan.
